subject.title: feat(ios): word-paced fade-in for streaming assistant prose

question: Should OpenClaw accept word-paced streaming reveal in the shared iOS/macOS chat renderer after the typography blocker and visual proof gap are resolved?
rationale: Automation can identify and repair the typography audit blocker, but it cannot make the final product call for a new user-visible motion behavior in chat.

options.title: Accept after blocker and proof
options.body: Fix the typography audit issue, add real visual proof for streaming and Reduce Motion, then continue normal maintainer review for this UX polish slice.

options.title: Defer to the polish issue
options.body: Leave the broader mobile polish issue open and close or pause this PR until streaming reveal is explicitly prioritized.

options.title: Request a narrower prototype
options.body: Ask for a smaller visual proof or design review before taking the renderer changes into the main app.

recommendation.title: Accept after blocker and proof
recommendation.body: Fix the typography audit issue, add real visual proof for streaming and Reduce Motion, then continue normal maintainer review for this UX polish slice.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the linked polish issue and has the strongest recent history on the affected mobile chat renderer path.
